text:
akash: FYI I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4824 — adds partitioning + new index to raw_events to speed ETL. Planning to merge TOMORROW 11:30am PST unless there are objections. Need 2 approvals. :eyes:

maria: Checck — is there a backfill plan? how long will the downstream ETL be paused?

akash: Short summary: no downtime for reads. We'll add PARTITION BY RANGE on event_date and create index concurrently. Backfill runs as separate job that writes into new partitions via insert-select. Estimated ~120M rows, ~3 hours at current cluster throughput. Canary on last 7 days first.

jordan: Can you paste the migration SQL here? want to eyeball locks 

akash: Sure — simplified snippet:
```sql
-- create partitions + index concurrently
ALTER TABLE raw_events ADD COLUMN event_date DATE;
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_raw_events_event_date ON raw_events (event_date);
-- partitioning (Postgres declarative partitioning example)
ALTER TABLE raw_events PARTITION BY RANGE (event_date);
-- create a new partition for 2026-04
CREATE TABLE raw_events_202604 PARTITION OF raw_events FOR VALUES FROM ('2026-04-01') TO ('2026-05-01');
```

maria: Looks ok but we need a safety toggle in the deploy runbook. Also add a check that concurrent index finishes before we start backfill job.

olivia: +1 on runbook. For backfill we'll use the ETL job with --dry-run first, and then limited concurrency. Proposed steps: canary (7d) -> spot-check consumer joins -> full backfill with throttling. I can add the airflow DAG flag so we can cancel quickly.

jordan: What about long-running transactions during ALTER? If this is postgres, partitioning alter can be heavy. Are we doing a copy+swap pattern?

akash: We're doing a non-blocking approach: add column + create partitions + attach partitions via chunked copy into new partition tables, then swap table reference in the app layer (feature flag). No global table rewrite. I'll add details in the PR description.

maria: Who's owning the merge window? I can be oncall during the backfill window if anything goes sideways.

akash: Thanks — can you be the primary pager? @maria will be primary, @jordan secondary. I'll be running the backfill job.

jordan: quick note — please include a query to verify row counts per partition and a checksum sample. e.g. `SELECT count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE event_date >= '2026-04-01'`

akash: Added verification steps + rollback plan in PR. Rollback: stop ETL jobs, switch feature flag to old table, drop new partitions after investigation.

sre-bot: Scheduled maintenance window reminder: eng-infra maintenance slot tomorrow 11:00-13:00 PST. Add incident channel if you expect user-facing impact.

olivia: I'll add a short runbook section to the PR and attach the airflow DAG change. Also will run the canary at 09:30 tomorrow and post results.

maria: I can approve after runbook added and the dry-run succeeds. Please ping me when dry-run complete. :thumbsup:

akash: Will do. pinging reviewers: @maria @jordan @olivia — can someone take a look at the DB migration SQL + runbook? Need two approvals to merge tomorrow.

jordan: I'll review tonight and leave comments.

olivia: Reviewed the DAG change — minor nit on retry count. Left comment on PR.

maria: Dry-run completed at 09:37 — canary looks good (no consumer errors on sample). Approving now.

akash: Thanks all — tagging merge window: merging at 11:30 PST if no further blockers.

jordan: Approved.

akash: Merge done at 11:31, backfill started. Will update thread with progress and any incidents. :rocket:
